title: A Subversion wc.db is served (/.svn/wc.db)
summary: The Subversion working copy database is downloadable, which names every file in the repository and lets the source be rebuilt.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("SQLite format 3") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Block the .svn directory at the web server, or deploy without it.
